text:
Eleni M.: hey all, day 1! quick obs setup blockers: 1) which Datadog API key to use for local smoke tests vs k8s? 2) Grafana only shows Platform Overview for me, can't find our service folder. 3) Sentry says 'no org access' after SSO. who do i ping for each?

onboard-bot: Welcome Eleni! Please follow the onboarding checklist: https://go.redwood/onboard-checklist and file the observability access form: https://go.redwood/obs-access-form. DevEx will assist. :wave:

Jules (DevEx): welcome! short: Datadog keys are per-user in 1Password under redwood/integrations/datadog/dev. For local: export DD_API_KEY and DD_ENV=dev. For k8s: create a secret (e.g., `kubectl create secret generic dd-api --from-literal=api-key=$DD_API_KEY -n dev`) and reference it in helm (datadog.apiKeyExistingSecret).

Maya (Observability): i just added you to the SSO group that maps to team folders and re-sent the Sentry invite to eleni@redwood.com — check spam. i also shared the read-only "Starter: Observability" dashboard with you. If you need edit on a specific panel, name it and i'll grant.

Ravi (Platform): FYI local agent uploads count toward ingestion. for quick UI checks run the agent without cloud upload or set very low sample rates. example: run agent with `--no-cloud-upload` or set trace sampling to 0.01.

Eleni M.: saw the grafana folder after logout/login, Sentry invite arrived, created the k8s secret and set DD_ENV=dev. will use no-cloud-upload while iterating. thanks everyone :tada: closing thread.
